segments.t: At the talent agency, IT specialist Nathan confirms that the leaked movie contract was photocopied in their own offices in the middle of the night. Andrea confronts Mathias over his maneuvers to take control of ASK. When Hicham Janowski suddenly offers to sell his shares, the corporate battle reaches an unexpected turning point. Let's listen to the scene in French first.

Nous verrons bien ce soir.
